run_nms_2d: run non-maximum suppression on 2D axis-aligned boxes with overlap threshold filtering
run_nms_2d_faster: run faster non-maximum suppression on 2D boxes using IoU-based overlap calculation
run_nms_3d_faster: run faster non-maximum suppression on 3D axis-aligned boxes with IoU overlap threshold
run_nms_3d_faster_samecls: run 3D non-maximum suppression that only suppresses boxes sharing the same class label
run_nms_crnr_dist: run non-maximum suppression using bounding box corner distance measure for overlap
